additional_info.subject: Ladestation liefert nicht volle Leistung
additional_info.body:
Guten Tag,
könnten Sie einmal prüfen auf welche maximale Leistung der Charger eingestellt ist? Wir hatten erst vermutet das es am Lastmanagement von Siemens liegt und haben nun auf unser internes vom Backend gewechselt, leider wird weiterhin nur mit ca. 330KW geladen. Uns ist bewusst das in den Logs steht das z.B. der Charger 418A anbietet, das Fahrzeug aber nur 416A nachfragt. An jeder anderen Ladestation außerhalb von unseren Ladepark lädt das Fahrzeug aber schneller.
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
: AH5065DC001
Charger ID
: fDzl60
Problem Description
: The charging station is not delivering full power.
Wir benötigen für diesen Fall unbedingt eine Lösung.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
#gerneperdu
Lennart Meiners
Business Operation and Strategy Manager

additional_info.subject: ID0480906-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / S6 170003725] Charger's Power Query CRM:03431000116
additional_info.body:
Dear Lennart,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, we see that the maximum power in the configuration is still 360kw.
This also shows in the logs. In the following log you are able to see that the charger is able to deliver the maximum power of 360kw during the pre-charge.
Answering your second question, the duration of a charging session depends on many different factors, for example:
- The model of the car
- The state of the battery of the car
- The percentage of the battery of the car, when the charging session started.
If you would like us to be more specific, you can provide us with the model of the car, and we will send you the charging curve for our charger regarding that model.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0480906-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / S6 170003725] Charger's Power Query CRM:03431000116
additional_info.body:
Dear Lennart,
Thank you for your quick response.
We understand your question, and understand that this may seem odd.
Every charger charges in a different way, if there would be something wrong with the charging power, this would show in the configuration, the pre-charge or in the error flags. This is not the case.
During all the charging sessions we checked the charger is always providing the kw of what the car is asking.
We hope this answered your question.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
